system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: An agent reads your sources, synthesizes a linked Markdown wiki you own
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt files src/agent/prompt.ts, prompts/code.ts, prompts/personal.ts suggest mode-selected templates; not opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The coding agent investigates the repository, plans the wiki, and writes each assigned page sequentially with its native repository tools.

context_compaction.note: test/agent/conversation-history-offload.test.ts and checkpoint-pruning.test.ts hint at compaction but file contents unavailable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: deterministic connector tools write raw data and manifests under `~/.openwiki/connectors/<connector>/raw/`

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The `openai` provider routes tool calls through the Responses API (`/v1/responses`)

tool_count.evidence_quote: The integration exposes the same five operations as native generation: `openwiki_begin`, `openwiki_submit_plan`, `openwiki_next_page`, `openwiki_submit_page`, and `openwiki_finish`.
tool_count.note: Five MCP page-job operations for host-driven runs; native agent tool count (file/shell tools from Deep Agents) not enumerated in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: OpenWiki internally preserves, updates, creates, or retracts Claims and refuses to finish until the final state is durable.
edit_primitive.note: Pages are submitted as complete content via submit_page; no diff/search-replace primitive described.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: `custom-mcp` connects to any configured HTTP or stdio MCP server and permits only explicitly safe, read-only tools.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP connector tools plus locally defined tools (src/integrations/mcp/server.ts); generation method not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: OpenWiki provides the durable MCP page-job lifecycle, validates each completion
protocol_standardization.note: MCP server for integrations and MCP client for connectors.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: repository generation now follows `begin → submit_plan → next_page → submit_page → … → finish`, with a durable ordered page queue, focused per-page workers

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a durable ordered page queue, focused per-page workers, strict Claims persistence, and whole-plan invalidation when repository source changes

multi_agent_topology.note: Built with Deep Agents; per-page workers dispatched from a durable queue.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: focused per-page workers, strict Claims persistence
delegation_mechanism.note: Per-page worker runs inferred as sub-agent invocations; code not inspected.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: By default the CLI stays open after a run so you can send follow-up messages.
human_in_loop.note: Follow-up chat is not per-action gating; no approval mechanism described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: OpenWiki records in-progress repository generation in `openwiki/.run.json`, so rerunning the same command after an interruption resumes the durable page queue.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: OpenWiki stores local credentials, the personal wiki, connector data, conversation history, and skills under `~/.openwiki` by default.
long_term_memory.note: Wiki itself is read as agent memory; skills/ directory ships SKILL.md files.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Interrupted runs can resume when the same checkout persists; ephemeral CI runners do not retain uncommitted run state after failure.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After each run, OpenWiki validates every `mermaid` fence. A diagram that fails validation is converted in place to a plain `text` fence
self_verification.note: Harness-run validators: mermaid validation, wiki link validation, OKF frontmatter validation, Claims evidence recheck.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: OpenWiki uses LangChain's retry handling for transient provider errors. Override the retry count (default 3)
retry_policy.evidence_locator: README.md Alternative base URLs, OpenRouter pinning, and retries
retry_policy.note: Only transport-level retries; no task-level re-attempt policy described.

rollback.evidence_quote: A setup failure before the new run state is durable restores the previous wiki.
rollback.note: Only a setup-failure restore of the previous wiki; no git reset or snapshot rollback mechanism described.

termination_condition.note: Run ends when the finish operation completes the page queue; no step/cost caps described.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: OpenWiki uses a 16,384-token per-request default for modern Claude 4/5 models
cost_controls.evidence_locator: README.md Alternative base URLs, OpenRouter pinning, and retries
cost_controls.note: Per-request output-token caps (OPENWIKI_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, OPENWIKI_OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS); no run-level cost cap found.

timeouts.evidence_quote: set `OPENWIKI_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT` to control how long the client waits for the first or next streamed response chunk
timeouts.evidence_locator: README.md Alternative base URLs, OpenRouter pinning, and retries
timeouts.note: Only a Bedrock stream idle timeout is documented; no run-level timeout.

execution_isolation.note: Runs as a local CLI on the host repository checkout; no container mentioned.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: When `.openwikiignore` has active rules, OpenWiki filters filesystem discovery and restricts shell execute so ignored paths stay out of the run.
filesystem_access.note: Host filesystem within the repo/state dirs; ignore rules scope reads.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The page loads its graph, Markdown, and diagram libraries from a public CDN, so an internet connection is required
network_policy.note: No egress restriction described; connectors call arbitrary APIs. Visualizer server binds loopback only.

permission_model.evidence_quote: `custom-mcp` connects to any configured HTTP or stdio MCP server and permits only explicitly safe, read-only tools.
permission_model.note: Read-only tool allowlist for MCP plus .openwikiignore path restrictions; no per-call human approval.

tracing.evidence_quote: it pulls recent LangSmith traces (tool calls, outcomes, and latency) for the projects you choose through the official LangSmith SDK
tracing.note: Optional LangSmith tracing configured via /langsmith-key; telemetry events and .last-update.json also recorded.

replayability.evidence_quote: Interrupted runs can resume when the same checkout persists
replayability.note: evals/ledger/replay/git-replay.ts exists in tree for eval replay.

eval_hooks.note: evals/ledger benchmark suite and evals/deepswe ship in the pinned repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: OpenWiki filters filesystem discovery and restricts shell execute so ignored paths stay out of the run
guardrails.note: Also src/cli/diagnostics/sanitize.ts and stream-redaction tests indicate output redaction.

target_domain.evidence_quote: OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains a wiki for your codebase or your personal knowledge.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Thirteen model providers out of the box, from OpenAI and Anthropic to Bedrock, Gemini, and any OpenAI-compatible gateway.

first_release_date.note: No tag history or first-release date in the evidence.

stars.note: Star count not present in evidence.
